# Hallbridge Talent Partners

> Hallbridge Talent Partners (Hallbridge LLC) is a construction executive search and recruiting firm in the United States. It places project managers, superintendents, project engineers, estimators, preconstruction leaders and construction executives with general contractors, multifamily developers and engineering firms nationwide. Managing Partner: Alex Hall. Contact: info@hallbridge.co.

## Quick facts

- Focus: construction and AEC recruiting only, for more than 10 years
- Track record: 100+ construction professionals placed, 95% retention across placements
- Project types: high-rise, Class A multifamily, student housing, mixed-use and commercial, typically $20M to $100M+
- Coverage: nationwide, with placements in MA, NY, NJ, PA, VA, NC, SC, GA, FL, TN, IN, IL, TX, CO, UT, AZ, NV, CA, OR, WA and HI
- Clients: general contractors, multifamily developers (including NMHC top builders) and engineering firms (including ENR-ranked firms)

## Services

- Contingency search: no upfront cost; the fee is due only when a candidate is placed
- Retained search: dedicated, exclusive search for critical leadership and executive hires
- Market intelligence: compensation benchmarking, talent mapping and candidate availability

## Roles placed

- Field: Superintendent, Assistant Superintendent, Project Manager, Project Engineer, Assistant Field Staff
- Office and executive: Vice President, Director / Project Executive, Preconstruction Manager, Estimator, Civil Engineer

## For candidates

Hallbridge is paid by hiring companies and never charges candidates. Conversations are confidential. Candidates can send a resume to info@hallbridge.co.
